title: Sleep, Focus, and When to Seek Help
summary: Difficulty sleeping, scattered attention, nail-biting, constant fatigue—these may be signs of ADHD, anxiety, or depression. A consistent sleep routine (9–11 hours), breaking tasks into smaller parts, and immediate rewards can help. If symptoms persist for weeks and affect school or home life: consult a pediatrician or child psychologist.
try_this: This week: Establish a fixed sleep schedule (same time every night, no screens an hour before bed, reading or relaxation). Observe: Has their focus improved in the morning?
reflection_prompts: Have you noticed an improvement in their focus or mood?
warning_flags: تأثير على الأداء الدراسي أو العلاقات

review_defects.why: The Arabic specifies a psychiatrist (طبيب نفسي, a medical doctor), while the English uses 'child psychologist', which is a different profession. This could affect the type of help recommended.
